name: pyramid-task
description: Plan and assure brownfield software changes with evidence-backed task pyramids, impact analysis, inspections, audit gates, migration, dossiers, and interactive overlays.

interface.shortDescription: Brownfield change assurance for agents and humans.
interface.longDescription: Turn an intent into a validated pathfinder graph, baseline an existing system, map change impact, enforce inspection-aware audit gates, migrate active V2 plans without rebuilding, carry the verified baseline through the full lifecycle, and explore interactive task and assurance overlays.
defaultPrompt: Turn this feature into an evidence-backed task pyramid.
Assess this existing system and map the change impact before implementation.
Upgrade this running V2.1 plan to V3 without rebuilding it.
Show what is ready, active, blocked, and unaudited.
Propose and preview a safe expansion for this broad task.
